description: Retrospective application for installation of 1 gas riser to the rear elevation and installation of micro-stop to existing riser with associated internal works to Flats 1-5.
decision_conditions:
REVIEW OF GAS PIPEWORK (DETAILS): Within one year of the date of this consent, details of a review of the external gas pipework installation shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. The review shall assess the continued necessity of the existing arrangement and examine opportunities to rationalise, reduce, relocate or otherwise minimise the extent and visual impact of the exposed pipework, having regard to operational, safety and heritage considerations. Where the review identifies a feasible alternative or improvement, details of the proposed works and a timetable for implementation shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and thereafter implemented in accordance with the approved timetable.
 
REASON: The external pipework adversely affects the significance of the Grade II listed terrace. The arrangement has been accepted on a temporary basis in light of the exceptional circumstances surrounding the emergency works and the public benefits associated with maintaining essential services. This condition is imposed to ensure that opportunities for a more sensitive long-term solution are kept under review and implemented where feasible in order to better preserve the special architectural and historic interest of the terrace.
status: Called in by Secretary of State
